author: everestmcarthur
description: The ultimate Discord event logging system. Captures every single Discord event with individual toggles, advanced filtering, customizable formats (detailed/compact/JSON), and comprehensive tracking of all Discord gateway events.
install_msg: Thanks for installing RubyLogging! Use `[p]rlog quickstart #channel` to get started, or `[p]rlog list` to see all 100+ available events.
short: Ultimate event logger - every Discord event, individually toggleable
